description: This script generates and exports MISP events, including signing, saving event data, hashes, and manifest, based on a set of configurations and filters.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the PyMISP instance and sets up valid attribute distributions.

methods.name: saveEvent
methods.description: Saves a single event as JSON and optionally signs it, writing to output files.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Generates a signature for an event using the MISP instance.

methods.name: saveHashes
methods.description: Saves a list of hashes to a CSV file.

methods.name: saveManifest
methods.description: Saves the manifest data to a JSON file.
